kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid (KJV 18:4)
mine: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of destruction assailed me
note: hevle mawet are "cords of death" (parallel "cords of Sheol", "snares of death"), though hevel can also mean "pangs"; nahale veliya'al are "torrents of destruction/Belial", the chaos waters, not "ungodly men".

kjv: with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward (KJV 18:26)
mine: with the crooked you make yourself seem tortuous
note: 'iqqesh "crooked, perverse" and titpattal "you show yourself twisted/shrewd"; "froward" is obsolete (cf. 2Sa 22:27).
